title: LatexDo 1.0
summary: LatexDo reaches 1.0: sentence completion, project search in Cmd/Ctrl+F, a notification center, and redesigned table and notation tools.

highlights.title: Finish the sentence you are writing
highlights.description: Pause while writing and LatexDo offers the rest of the sentence as grey text. Tab keeps it; typing or Escape dismisses it.

highlights.title: A table generator that works like a spreadsheet
highlights.description: Type cells directly, move with Tab and Enter, paste from Excel or Sheets, set each column's alignment, and choose grid, booktabs or minimal rules. Add a caption and label in one click.

highlights.title: A clearer notation manager
highlights.description: Detected symbols are listed one per row with their line and section, and can be filtered by undefined, conflicting or defined.

highlights.title: Project search in Cmd/Ctrl+F
highlights.description: Search the whole project from the same place you search the open file.

highlights.title: A notification center
highlights.description: Errors and system events are collected in one place instead of disappearing after a few seconds.

highlights.title: Built-in tools need no install
highlights.description: The table generator, notation manager, citation manager and TikZ converter are ready from the first launch. The store now offers content packs.

fixes: Fixed notation detection reporting the letters inside commands such as \alpha as separate symbols and conflicts.
Fixed typing being interrupted right after accepting a citation.
Fixed encoded spaces in file names shown in Problems.
Fixed a downloaded local AI model not being recognised at launch.

security.title: Updates come only from LatexDo's release repository
security.description: LatexDo installs updates only from latexdo.org downloads and the latexdo/latexdo-desktop releases, and checks every installer against the signed update feed.
